note: Dock ring (purple, top) and blank dock plate (tan, lifted out 12 mm below the ring) seen from BELOW (iso-bottom-right, true isometric, transparent background). The 4 F9 nylon plate screws are pulled 30 mm straight down (screen: straight down) from the 5.2 mm counterbores in the plate underside; insertion direction is +z (up through plate into the F8 inserts in the ring bosses, which are hidden above the plate). arrow_to = pixel of the counterbore opening in the plate underside. CAUTION: the model has no M2.5 x 5 screw; the picture reuses the 6 mm stainless-style socket screw body drawn in off-white. The real F9 is a nylon M2.5 x 5 pan head screw (kit M2.5 x 6 with 1 mm cut off). The round hole in the plate is the radar aperture; the same four-point layout applies to the A6, A2 and A5 plates.
